polls.description: Major public opposition and regulatory concerns are forcing tech companies to reconsider massive AI infrastructure investments globally.
polls.question: Should communities have veto power over AI data center projects?

cluster_stories.title: Google unveils $15 billion data centre investment in Malaysia
cluster_stories.summary: Google announced plans on Wednesday to invest $15 billion in Malaysia over the next two years to build data centres and other infrastructure as demand booms for artificial intelligence services. It said the $15 billion investment will be made "over the next two years (2027 to 2028)", expanding on a $2 billion investment announced in 2024.
cluster_stories.headline: GOOGLE DROPS $15 BILLION on Malaysia AI Data Centres

cluster_stories.title: Activists across Europe prepare two days of protests against datacentres
cluster_stories.summary: More than 100 campaign groups will join together in 15 countries this week to call for a halt to major AI projectsProtesters across Europe are planning two days of action against datacentres this week with demonstrations taking place in 15 countries.More than 100 groups are joining together for the “Stop Dirty Data Centres” events on Friday and Saturday. They are calling for a moratorium on large projects, citing environmental and social costs that “we can no longer afford”. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: EUROPE-WIDE PROTESTS Target AI Datacenters This Week

cluster_stories.title: US voters rejected AI data centres in 40 of 41 ballot measures
cluster_stories.summary: US voters sided against AI data centres in all but one of 41 local ballot measures on Tuesday. Democrats who campaigned against the build-out also won the governor’s races in Texas, Ohio and Georgia. The measures were spread across 10 states, according to Ballotpedia figures and results gathered by CNBC. Ohio held 21 of them. […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: VOTERS REJECT AI DATA CENTERS in 40 of 41 US Ballot Measures

cluster_stories.summary: Fresh blow ahead of start-up’s IPO as tech giant turns down option to more than double Texas data centre contract
cluster_stories.headline: Microsoft Rejects Nscale's Texas AI Data Centre Expansion

cluster_stories.title: Microsoft rejects multibillion-dollar AI deal with UK's Nscale
cluster_stories.summary: The report comes weeks after Microsoft pulled out of a deal to anchor Nscale's flagship data centre project in Loughton, Essex, after power connection delays pushed its expected supply date into the 2030s
cluster_stories.headline: MICROSOFT KILLS Multibillion-Dollar UK AI Data Centre Deal

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI to Change How It Handles Data Center Efforts After Outcry
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI said it will avoid nondisclosure agreements when it negotiates data center deals and ensure residents don’t pay for the electricity to power those projects, part of a framework the company believes should be adopted into laws governing the expansion of artificial intelligence.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI CHANGES DATA CENTER DEALS AFTER PUBLIC BACKLASH

cluster_stories.title: UK found to be ‘dangerously’ reliant on China for critical minerals needed for defence and AI
cluster_stories.summary: Delivering net zero also at risk, say MPs as they call for centralised policy and funding for mines and diversification The UK is “dangerously” dependent on China for critical raw materials needed for the military, renewable energy infrastructure and AI, a parliamentary investigation has found.MPs on the business select committee called for an urgent centralised policy and the creation of a “critical minerals finance facility” to help fund rare earth and other critical mineral mines, and deploy grants, equity and debt to accelerate a diversification programme. cluster_stories.summary: China has blocked the sale of ABB Ltd.’s robotics unit to SoftBank Group Corp., dealing a blow to the Japanese investment firm’s plans to expand into physical AI.
cluster_stories.headline: China Halts SoftBank's Physical AI Expansion Plans

cluster_stories.title: The US-China tech contest has moved – to the gatekeeping product testers
cluster_stories.summary: The latest front in the US-China technology contest is not advanced chips, artificial intelligence (AI) or telecommunications equipment. It is the laboratories that certify whether an electronic product may enter the American market. cluster_stories.headline: US-China Tech War Shifts to Product Testing Labs
